title: The Way Down to Nothing
notes: Artifacts of the living gods: 9 more, one from each living god. Celmiss's Sewing Needle (overhealing is stitched into a shield), Cevel's Glass Eye (a floating eye: 25% of your damage echoes onto the same target), Gaeliel's Wind Chime (every 5th hit calls lightning onto everything you've just hit), Delthius's Tea Set (every 30s a reading names an element: that damage is doubled), Gulthus's Gardening Gloves (kills plant grave-flowers that heal allies and poison enemies), Mvrow's Collar (your oldest summon, or a spirit hound, strikes what you strike and can't die while you live), Kryuleiza's Mirror (a big hit summons a mirror image that casts what you cast), Lifius's Watering Can (healing grows a sapling that boosts your damage) and The Truth of Nothingness.

The Truth of Nothingness, Obliveion's scroll: 15% of the damage you'd take is simply erased (before resistances; one scroll counts), and what you kill leaves no corpse. And it hides a secret: "Find the way down to me."

The Negative Ascensions: with the scroll, the Way Down at Ascension 1 goes further down, to Ascension -1 and on to -100, where reality is breaking. They are harder than the climb above, between them lie hollow camps (an altar and a stash, nothing living), and they don't count toward the climb. At Ascension -100, something waits for you.
The Mystic's window now opens beside your Trinket Pouch, instead of listing every charm in a long column: right-click a charm in the pouch to put it on her altar.
